name: Famous Name, New Product!

pick.label: Pick a celebrity
pick.heading: Pick a celebrity and launch their product line
lead: These days it seems every famous person has a product line: make-up, tequila, hot sauce, headphones, socks. Some of them are brilliant. Some of them make you wonder who on earth said yes.
Choose a famous person (or a famous not-quite-person) and launch a product line with their name on it. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *The less obvious the product, the better.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: This is just for fun, not a business plan. Be kind to your celebrity: we’re laughing with them, not at them.

rows: Who is putting their name on it?
What exactly are they selling? Make-up, food, clothes, something nobody has ever sold before?
Every celebrity line needs a name. A pun, a nickname, a catchphrase…
Why would fans believe this person really uses it? (Or why does it make no sense at all, in a good way?)
Where is it, who’s in it, and what happens?
How much, and is that a bargain or a rip-off?

values.product: Football socks, plus a matching pair for the sofa, for people who watch a lot more football than they play.
values.name: Raumdeuter Socks. Nobody outside Germany will understand the name, and that’s the point.
values.why: He is famous for always being in exactly the right place without anybody quite knowing how. Lost socks are exactly the same.
values.ad: Müller on a sofa in Friedrichshain, looking for the remote control. He finds it straight away, obviously.
values.price: €19.99 for three pairs, which is a rip-off, but they come in a little box shaped like a goal.

yours.label: Your product line
yours.heading: Your idea
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your product line in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which product line wins?
rank.placeholder: The product line, e.g. Raumdeuter Socks
